scripts.lint: pnpm deployment:check:all && pnpm ai:validate && pnpm ai:eval && pnpm -r --if-present lint
scripts.backend:lint: uv run --project apps/backend ruff check apps/backend/src apps/backend/tests
scripts.backend:migrations: uv run --project apps/backend python apps/backend/manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run --settings=saas_core.config.settings.migration_check
scripts.backend:typecheck: uv run --project apps/backend mypy --config-file apps/backend/pyproject.toml apps/backend/src
scripts.backend:check: pnpm backend:lint && pnpm backend:imports && pnpm backend:migrations && pnpm backend:typecheck && pnpm backend:test
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deployment:check:all: pnpm deployment:check --profile core-only && pnpm deployment:check --profile business && pnpm deployment:check --profile vps-dev && pnpm deployment:check --profile hoofcare && pnpm deployment:check --profile medplano && pnpm deployment:artifact:check
scripts.runtime:logs: docker compose logs --follow caddy frontend backend worker scheduler
scripts.api:schema: uv run --project apps/backend python apps/backend/manage.py spectacular --file packages/contracts/openapi/v1.yaml --validate --settings=saas_core.config.settings.test
scripts.quality: pnpm check && pnpm backend:check && pnpm api:check
